Students from countries where humanitarian organisations report violated human rights and freedoms, and where discriminatory measures restrict access to education, may apply once they have been admitted and enrolled in a degree programme at a Charles University faculty through the standard admissions procedure. The bursary is governed by Rector's Directive No. 56/2025, effective from 22 December 2025.

new_scholarship.name: Tuition Fee Waiver for International non-EU/EEA MSc Students - Technical University of Denmark
new_scholarship.description: The Technical University of Denmark has a very limited number of tuition fee waivers to award International new non-EU/EEA MSc students applying for the Autumn intake. The waivers are allocated to students with excellent academic performance and a waiver covers the tuition fee for the two years of the MSc programme. Waivers are only available for the Autumn intake and are not offered for the Spring intake. Applicants must apply by the 15 January deadline and submit a separate personal statement specifying that they are applying for the waiver, because applications without that statement are not considered.

The companion dates page confirms "15 January - Application deadline - Non-EU" for the Autumn intake and "April - Tuition fee waivers announced - Non-EU".
